item.title: Community Outdoor Warning Sirens to be activated in Logan Co. on Tuesday
item.description: LOGAN COUNTY, Ky. – The Community Outdoor Warning Sirens will be activated throughout Logan County on Tuesday, Feb. 3. That’s according to social media post by the Logan County Emergency Communications Center. Emergency officials say the sirens will sound due to some work being done on the COWS system. The communications center asks that residents disregard the sirens.
